title: Continuous Vetting Analyst
description:

As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™
Continuous Vetting (CV) Analyst The Continuous Vetting (CV) Analyst provides mission-critical support to federal government programs by reviewing, analyzing, and processing information related to personnel security vetting. This role supports the Case Processing Operations Center (CPOC) contract within the Defense and Intelligence Operating Group and ensures all activities are executed in full compliance with contractual performance standards, federal regulations, and security policy.
Key Role/Responsibilities:

• Review Continuous Vetting alerts submitted through authorized channels.

• Utilize government-furnished systems to verify whether alerts are new, valid, and properly attributed to the correct subject.

• Identify, document, and assess issues that triggered each alert in accordance with federal vetting guidelines and contract-defined workflows.

• Recommend and record appropriate follow up actions necessary to support issue resolution, ensuring compliance with federal investigative standards.

• Input and update case, subject, and investigative details in multiple government systems and databases.

• When applicable, initiate investigations, prepare case materials, and coordinate required documentation for Field Investigators following contract and agency procedures.

• Cross train across functional areas and provide surge or support coverage to meet contract service levels and mission needs.

• Maintain established quality, timeliness, and productivity benchmarks as defined by performance standards and federal requirements.

• Participate in additional assignments and special projects that support operational objectives, contract obligations, or evolving government needs.

Basic Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in government contracting, personnel security, or administrative support.

• Ability to type at least 40 words per minute.

• Proficiency with computers, including Microsoft Office or comparable applications.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to interpret procedure manuals, email correspondence, and detailed instructions.

• Capability to manage and complete assignments independently with minimal supervision.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule based on workload demands, including potential evening and weekend hours.

• Must consent to a government background investigation.

• U.S. citizenship required due to contract requirements.

• Ability to work a 40+ hour schedule.

• Must reside within the Eastern Time Zone.

Work will be performed primarily in a remote capacity. If the employee resides within a one hour driving distance of Iron Mountain in Boyers, PA, occasional on site attendance may be required. NOTE: Orientation will be performed on-site at Iron Mountain, Boyers, PA, ASRC Federal PMO office.

• Work is performed using company furnished laptop or desktop. Position requires the ability to sit for extended periods of time.

• Ability to walk extended distance to work department when working on-site or use of bus transportation.

• Other physical activity may include reaching, bending, lifting, finger dexterity and repetitive motion.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:

- Робота в середовищі яке росте та змінюється, а отже процеси не завжди «з коробки»

- На те, як юридична функція підтримує бізнес, а не просто обслуговує його

Що для нас важливо:
• Досвід самостійної роботи з корпоративними документами, а не лише «під наглядом»

• Системне мислення: вміння бачити не окремий документ, а процес і ризики навколо нього
• Комфорт у міжнародному середовищі та щоденній роботі англійською мовою

title: Senior Manager, Quality and Safety — Cardiac PET/CT
description:
THE COMPANY
At Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA), we believe that the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high and the optimal way to identify and remove the avoidable costs in cardiovascular care delivery is by equipping and empowering cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives via risk-based contracts.

Position Summary
CVAUSA is seeking a Senior Manager of Quality and Safety for Cardiac PET to lead the standardization and continuous improvement of cardiac PET/CT imaging across our network of community cardiology practices. This person will own the quality framework for one of the fastest-growing and most technically demanding imaging modalities in cardiovascular care - setting the standards, building the improvement programs, and working directly with practices to raise the floor and the ceiling on imaging quality, patient safety, and diagnostic accuracy. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent years inside real-world cardiac PET programs, knows exactly where quality tends to break down in community practice, and is energized by the work of closing those gaps at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Quality Program Development & Management

• Refine, implement, and iteratively improve upon CVAUSA’s initial quality and safety program for cardiac PET/CT across CVAUSA’s practice network.

• Establish and maintain quality metrics, protocols, and standard operating procedures spanning acquisition, stress protocols, tracer handling, quantification (myocardial blood flow / flow reserve), and interpretation.

• Build dashboards and reporting that make imaging quality and outcomes visible and actionable at both the network and individual-site level.

Accreditation

• Serve as the network's subject-matter expert on PET/CT accreditation requirements (e.g., IAC, ACR) and ensure practices meet or exceed accreditation quality criteria.

• Support practices as needed through initial accreditation and re-accreditation as needed, including documentation, QC records, and required competencies.

• Partner with the Medical Director and Radiation Safety Officer, who retain final sign-off on all clinical protocol specifics (dosing, contraindications, supervision levels) driven through this role.

Peer Review & Clinical Validation

• Establish and run routine peer review / over-read programs for interpreting physicians, with structured feedback and improvement pathways.

• Design and operationalize systematic comparisons of PET/CT findings against invasive coronary angiography, using discordance analysis to identify interpretation, protocol, and quantification issues and drive corrective action.

• Design analyses that leverage billing and electronic health record data to understand patterns of care quality and identify variations in utilization and clinical outcomes across practices and patient populations.

Training & Competency

• Implement, refine, and iteratively improve upon existing quality-focused training and competency requirements for interpreting clinicians.

• Develop training content to help standardize clinician continuing education for PET/CT.

Site Assessment & Standardization

• Travel to affiliated practices to assess PET/CT programs end to end - equipment and QC, protocols, staff competency, workflow, and image quality.

• Identify site-specific and network-wide sources of variation and poor-quality imaging (e.g., PET/CT misregistration and attenuation-correction artifacts, patient motion, stress protocol inconsistency, generator/tracer handling, calibration and QC gaps, reader variability) and lead remediation.

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

• Apply core quality-improvement methodology (e.g., PDSA cycles, root-cause analysis, statistical process control) to reduce variation and improve diagnostic accuracy and safety.

• Set benchmarks, track performance over time, and partner with practice leadership to sustain gains.

Required Qualifications

• 5-10+ years

title: Director of Performance Marketing
description:
About Homeaglow
Homeaglow ’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.
We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.
Why Join Homeaglow ?
A True Startup Environment
Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.
Sustained, Profitable Growth
Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households - with significant runway ahead.
Strong Unit Economics
Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.
Bootstrapped & Focused
No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.
Real Economic Impact
Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.
Vertical Expansion Strategy
Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.
Building a World-Class Team
Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform
About the Role
This is the senior leadership role responsible for Homeaglow 's paid acquisition machine. You will set the strategy, manage the budget, build the team, and be accountable for the acquisition numbers that drive the business. You will also be responsible for continuously strengthening our measurement capabilities and pushing the function toward greater automation and efficiency.
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Creative to improve every step of the customer journey, from the first ad impression through a completed booking. This is a hands-on leadership role in a remote-first company that rewards clear thinking, rigorous execution, and concise communication.
Key Responsibilities
Multi-Channel Acquisition

• Set and execute the paid acquisition strategy across search, social, affiliate, app install, direct mail, programmatic, CTV, and emerging channels.

• Think holistically about how channels work together to move customers from discovery to booking, and allocate investment accordingly.

• Continuously evaluate the channel mix: identify what to scale, what to test, and what to cut based on performance data and incrementality signals.

• Own acquisition strategy for both sides of the marketplace (consumers and cleaners), tailoring channel selection, messaging, and targeting to the distinct economics and behaviors of each audience.

Making Performance Legible

• Build and refine our measurement infrastructure in partnership with the Analytics team, covering attribution, incrementally testing, and LTV-based cohort analysis.

• Ensure that every significant spend decision is backed by a clear understanding of true channel contribution, not just platform-reported numbers.

• Develop and maintain a CAC model that gives visibility into cost efficiency by channel and customer segment, including how marginal costs shift at higher spend levels.

Budget Ownership and Financial Rigor

• Directly manage the performance marketing budget, including how dollars are distributed across channels, when to move money, and how the spend tracks against plan.

• Establish a regular review rhythm with Finance and marketing leadership: daily monitoring, weekly performance check-ins, and monthly investment reviews that connect spend to acquisition volume, CAC, and customer value.

• Reallocate budgets proactively when the data warrants it.

Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Functions

• The Advanced Practice Nurse will function within the scope of practice as defined by the state nurses practice act, delineation of privileges set forth by the practice setting and the American Nurses’ Association Code of Ethics. The advanced practice nurse utilizes the scientific process and national standards of care as a framework for managing patient care.

• The APP may provide therapeutic measures as appropriate and provide teaching, education and counseling to individuals, families and groups as indicated.

• For uncommon or unstable conditions, the APP will formulate diagnoses in consultation with his/her collaborating/supervising physician and either refer to a specialist or participate in the dual management and treatment with his/her collaborating/supervising physician.

• In addition to diagnosing and managing acute and chronic illnesses, APPs emphasize health promotion and disease prevention.

• APPs will serve as health care researchers, interdisciplinary consultants and patient advocates.

Proper documentation of medications prescribed, and refills authorized, will be reflected in the patient’s chart.

• The APP will stay current with medical trends and provide evidence-based practice medicine by completing the required continuing education as mandated by certifying organizations.

title: Driver / Data Collector in Sevilla, Spain
description:
Company description
 
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
 
Project Overview
 
This project aims to collect high-quality visuals of streets, key points of interest, and public spaces across EU countries. Using vehicles equipped with removable 360° cameras and lidars, drivers will capture comprehensive images of the surroundings. The captured data will be stored on onboard computers (SSD Drives)  and later utilized to enhance one of the world’s leading online mapping platforms.
 
Data collectors will follow pre-assigned routes, focusing on public streets, commercial areas, and points of interest. To ensure the highest image quality, certain areas may need to be revisited during favorable weather conditions. 
The duration of the project varies based on the scope of work required in each targeted data collection area. On average, the assignments involve 3 to 6 months of active work.
 
Work schedule: full time engagement within standard business hours (8 AM - 7 PM).
 
The recruitment process for the position of a Driver involves such steps: safety driving test, interview with recruiter, and onboarding process.

If you’re interested, apply now and join us in shaping the future of data collection!

title: Liquidity reporting Compliance
description:
This role sits as part of a first line compliance function to ensure that functionality, processes and reporting outputs built for Reporting Ops meet the regulatory criteria as documented by the relevant regulatory instructions, regulations and policies. This role will involve close liaison with both Finance Change colleagues as well as colleagues in Reporting Operations interacting with the Reporting Owner for the Liquidity Regulatory Reports.

Role Profile and Description of Responsibility

Build and lead a BAU compliance function to ensure that the Regulatory Reporting functionality built and released quarterly under various change epics delivered by Finance Change comply with the reporting requirements as detailed under the Reporting Instructions and Reporting Regulations from the local or group regulator, as well as any additional Policy Interpretations provided by Group Reg. Policy or local policy representatives.

The role will involve close liaison with the Product Owner for Liquidity Reporting in identifying the epics delivered in the previous release to be tested for compliance; documenting the test cases required for compliance testing by reference to required instructions, regulations and policy; managing test execution by a small team of dedicated testers; analyse test results for compliance with the testers; flag any items which require further investigation; identify any cases of non-compliance back to stakeholders including Reporting Ops and Report Owners; provide rapid feedback to the build team in cases of re-build required for compliance.

Required Skill Set

Deep subject matter knowledge and expertise in liquidity reporting constructs (for example LCR, NSFR, Maturity Ladders, etc).

Knowledge of core regulatory requirements including reporting instructions, regulations (for example CRR), and internal policies for liquidity reporting

Documentation capability to document test cases for testing whether delivered build output complies with reg & policy requirements (including but not limited to the logic, filter criteria, data attributes, frequency requirements, static reference data requirements)

Able to work at pace to ensure that quarterly cadence of delivery of change in liquidity reporting is maintained to ensure rapid feedback in case of any non-compliance

Able to develop and manage 2 x GCB 5 testers who will assist with test case script development, script execution in test environment (RADAR), validation of test outcomes to test expectations, investigations of unexpected outcomes

Able to engage at a senior level with Product Owner, Reporting Owner, Reporting Ops leads and ensure communication of compliance outcomes, tracking of delivery, and managing output.

Working knowledge of SQL to run query’s as required in the cloud platform test environment to support test case formulation, and to understand any logic build to verify code compliance to requirement.

Experience with use of ETL documents and related SQL scripts to understand detailed data transformations as well as being able to explain these to less technical colleagues

Understanding of banking products and the financial industry, with familiarity to complex trading structures such as Repos, Collateral Swaps and Derivatives

Competence in dealing with large complex datasets and using data analysis skills to manipulate and interrogate the data to produce findings

Able to engage with Finance Change business analysts, design & build and data analysts in cases of any non-compliance items found which require further remedial build, clearly articulating the cause of the non-compliance and the proposed remediation.

Able to engage with Reporting Ops to articulate all test findings, including compliant and non-compliant findings, alongside expected impact of any change requirements due to non-compliance defect fixes.

title: Solutions & Communications Architect (Fractional Contract)
description:
This is a remote position.
Job Description
We're building a secure, unified way for our team and systems to communicate with our central "Mission Control" - starting with email, and expanding over time to web, mobile, voice, and messaging.
We need a senior architect to lead this. The first month is a fast-paced, full-time build to get a secure, working pilot live. After that, the role shifts to a lighter, ongoing part-time role (about 8 hours a week) to maintain and grow what you built.
You'll move quickly, but never at the expense of security or approvals. If something's not safe or well understood, you're expected to pause and flag it - not just push through.

What You'll Own

• Understand the problem deeply before you start building

• Design the full system - how people and data are verified, protected, connected, and tracked

• Build in approval checkpoints so nothing sensitive goes out without human sign-off

• Launch a working pilot with monitoring, backup plans, and real proof that it works

• Review your team's work and stop or redirect anything unsafe or incomplete

• Document your decisions, the risks involved, and what should happen next

Requirements

What We're Looking For

• Senior-level experience in solution, enterprise, integration, platform, or security architecture

• A track record building AI-enabled workflows, case/work-management systems, or automated systems with audit trails

• Solid knowledge of identity/access management, data protection, and least-privilege design

• Experience building secure systems for multiple clients or organizations without mixing their data

• Comfortable using AI tools to help with analysis and design - but you check the work yourself

• Strong communicator who can explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical executives

Bonus Points

• Experience designing for users with very different tech skill levels

• A history of turning unclear requirements into a safe, working pilot - fast

• Confidence to say "stop" when something isn't secure or ready

You'll Thrive Here If You...

• Would rather build the right thing slowly than the wrong thing fast

• Take ownership of quality and security, not just "something that works"

• Enjoy high-trust, high-autonomy work where you decide when something's ready

• Are comfortable with an intense first month followed by a lighter, ongoing role

Benefits

Benefits

• HMO (health insurance)

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Work from anywhere

• Opportunities for promotion

• Pay raise

title: Manager, SKU Lifecycle Management
description:
We're hiring a Manager, SKU Lifecycle Management to join our Meal Kit Ingredient Development team at HelloFresh. In this role, you'll own and lead the SKU Lifecycle Management function - the operational backbone that keeps HelloFresh's product catalog accurate, compliant, and ready to scale across North America. You'll serve as the final approver for SKU activation and master data validation, own our US Private Label workflows, and act as the connective tissue between Procurement, Culinary, Supply Chain, Nutrition, Food Safety, and Sustainability teams. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives on bringing structure to complexity and cares deeply about data integrity.

You will … 

• Own end-to-end SKU and supplier onboarding and offboarding for North America - including tool management, master data auditing, physical SKU measurement, label verification, and serve as the final approver before any SKU is activated

• Lead Private Label workflows from initial request through design, versioning, costing, supplier confirmations, and final sign-off, while building scalable tracking, reporting, and a prioritization framework for which SKUs move to private label

• Maintain and continuously improve master data accuracy across HelloFresh's supply planning ecosystem, ensuring validated inputs flow correctly to downstream tools across Supply Chain and Operations

• Act as the primary cross-functional point of contact for SKU lifecycle questions - fielding and resolving inquiries related to labeling compliance, regulatory requirements, scan values, and master data from teams including Procurement, Culinary, Nutrition, Food Safety, and Sustainability

• Serve as the business owner for the tools that support SKU lifecycle management workflows - providing informed input on global system requirements and actively contributing to global process design and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Identify process gaps, define ownership for ambiguous or newly emerging workflows, and drive continuous improvement across SKU lifecycle processes - including onboarding edge cases, non-standard SKU types, and new brand partnerships
All other duties, as assigned

You are… 

• Detail-oriented - You apply meticulous scrutiny to validate supplier-provided data against source information, consistently catching errors before they reach downstream systems or go-live decisions

• A systems thinker - You understand how upstream data decisions ripple through supply planning tools and cross-functional teams, and you design processes with those downstream implications in mind

• A clear communicator - You can translate complex data questions and process ambiguity into actionable direction for a wide range of stakeholders, from suppliers to senior leadership

• Entrepreneurial - You're comfortable owning first-of-kind processes and building structure where none yet exists, without waiting to be told exactly how

• Collaborative - You move cross-functional work forward, keep diverse stakeholders aligned, and influence without authority

• Calm under pressure - You manage multiple high-visibility workstreams simultaneously - each with different stakeholders and timelines - without losing clarity or professionalism

You have… 

• 4-6 years of experience in supply chain operations, master data management, product or ingredient development, or a closely related field

• A demonstrated track record of owning and improving complex, cross-functional processes with multiple stakeholders across an organization

• Strong proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets; familiarity with supply planning or ERP systems (e.g., Jira, or equivalent tools) is a plus

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage high-volume, detail-intensive work with a high degree of accuracy and consistency

• A Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, Food Science, or a related field - or equivalent work experience

What you have

title: Triage Automation Engineer
description:
THE ROLE 

As a Triage Automation Engineer at Wayve, you'll play a key role in scaling our Triage and Detectives workflow through process improvement, tooling, and automation. You'll partner with Triage Specialists and Detective Engineers to turn repeated, manual analysis into reliable, productised automation, including triage bots, behavioural classifiers, and workflow tooling. That reduces manual load and speeds up how quickly we identify, understand, and resolve issues across our test and on-road fleets.

This is a highly collaborative, detail-oriented role with a direct impact on the safety and efficiency of Wayve's development pipeline.

Key responsibilities:

- Document and measure existing Triage and Detective workflows to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement

- Prioritise improvements based on cost, benefit, impact, and feasibility

- Partner with Detective Engineers to integrate their scripts and tools into scalable, productised workflows

- Work with development, ML, and AI teams to deliver the tooling improvements Triage needs

- Build automation pipelines - including triage bots and behavioural classifiers - that reduce manual load on Triage Specialists

- Validate automation changes and outputs, including the accuracy and reliability of classifications and suggested root causes

- Document newly implemented automations: what they do, how they work, how to use them, known limitations, and expected outputs

- Measure and report on triage quality and throughput to track the impact of automation

- Collaborate with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders to shape the roadmap for business-critical automation

- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (including trips to our London office)

ABOUT YOU  

In order to set you up for success as a Triage Automation Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.  

Essential 

- 3+ years of experience working with complex systems, ideally within robotics or autonomous vehicles

- Strong scripting and analytical skills (e.g. Python, SQL, Bash/Shell)

- Hands-on experience operating in a remote Linux environment

- Experience building or maintaining data pipelines or notebooks (e.g. Databricks, Jupyter)

- Great communication skills, able to explain complex technical problems to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Expertise using issue tracking and configuration management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket/GitLab

- Comfort with ambiguity - able to measure an existing workflow, identify where automation adds value, and scope a sensible solution

Desirable 

- Experience with web development languages (e.g. HTML, CSS, React, Java) for building internal tooling

- Practical experience with machine learning or classification models (e.g. PyTorch)

- Experience with cloud services (ideally Microsoft Azure)

- Passion for taking research ideas to production

- Track record of promoting statistical rigour and experimental best practice

- Experience working in a fast-moving tech company or startup

This is a full-time role based in our office in Sunnyvale.  At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $144,500-$183,200, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

title: Lead Cloud Architect
description:
Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Lead Cloud Architect to join a team responsible for the operational reliability and architecture of production systems running in AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud environments. Some system components are also deployed in Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The primary production workload runs on Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA).
This is a hands-on technical leadership role that combines cloud architecture, software engineering practices, and systems operations. The Lead Cloud Architect will design and implement scalable, secure, and reliable cloud solutions; define and monitor SLIs and SLOs; support application deployments and migrations across staging and production environments; and create and manage CI/CD pipelines. They will also lead incident response, drive automation to reduce operational toil, establish and promote cloud engineering best practices, and mentor junior Cloud Engineers.
This person partners closely with platform engineers, the security team, and application developers to ensure the infrastructure services are reliable, available, and deployed in a way that meets both developer and security requirements.
Location: Remote
Shift Schedule: 8am - 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST)
What you will do:

• Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational health of critical infrastructure services and applications, driving continuous improvement throughout their lifecycle.

• Lead complex production incidents and service recovery efforts, providing technical direction during high-impact events and driving thorough root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Define and continuously improve reliability objectives, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, service health metrics, and operational standards for infrastructure services and applications.

• Lead observability strategy in partnership with application teams, defining meaningful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts and ensuring they are integrated into the organization's observability capabilities.

• Lead the operational lifecycle of deployed services, including releases, upgrades, patching, configuration changes, capacity management, maintenance, and technology refreshes.

• Identify and drive the resolution of systemic reliability risks, recurring failure modes, capacity constraints, technical debt, and other sources of operational risk.

• Design and lead resilience and recovery initiatives, including failure-mode analysis, performance and capacity testing, disaster recovery, backup and failover strategies, and recovery validation.

• Develop and advance automation and everything-as-code practices to improve consistency, reliability, deployment, recovery, and overall operational efficiency.

• Partner with Platform Engineering and application teams on architecture and design, defining operational and reliability requirements and influencing platform capabilities and application architectures.

• Mentor junior Cloud Architects and provide technical leadership by establishing best practices, improving operational processes, and advancing the organization's overall reliability engineering maturity.

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:

• Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance.

• Bachelor's Degree and 12 years of experience, or Master's and 10 years of experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 16 years of experience.

• 7+ years hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or production systems engineering.

• Extensive hands-on experience operating in AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud, including OpenShift (ROSA) or comparable Kubernetes-based platforms

• Deep infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and Ansible / Ansible Tower.

• Advanced proficiency of GitLab and Jenkins CI/CD platforms, including reliability gating and deployment automation.

• Deep experience in Linux and Windows Server administration

title: Technical Support Specialist

Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity? 

With the advent of AI, the nature of customer support has changed dramatically - as have the humans who provide it. Our next Technical Support Specialist will be someone who thrives in autonomy, is deeply curious, fluent in AI tools and holds an extremely high bar not just for themselves, but for their teammates.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll own complex technical queries around some of our most nuanced features, serve as a point of escalation for your colleagues for the most tricky investigations, consistently provide world class customer support, collaborate with our customers proactively to help them make the most of our platform and help drive improvements in product, processes, and peer development. • Showcase successful and proactive communication about your training progress and needs/questions that arise.

In your first 60 days, you will: 

• Continue to complete CS trainings and pass relevant assessment

JOB TITLE: Manager of Applications Engineering (Professional Engineer) - EPS
DEPARTMENT: Electrical Power Solutions
SUPERVISOR: SVP of Engineering, Design, and Construction
SUMMARY:
Lightserve 's Electrical Power Solutions (EPS) is a leading Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) provider delivering distributed energy, power generation, battery energy storage (BESS), microgrid, and electrical infrastructure solutions. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Manager of Applications Engineering to lead the technical development and execution support of EPC projects throughout the project lifecycle.
The successful candidate will provide leadership to the Applications Engineering team responsible for conceptual design, project development, proposal support, equipment selection, utility interconnection coordination, technical risk assessment, and engineered construction deliverables. This role serves as the primary technical bridge between Business Development, Estimating, Operations, Procurement, and Customers, ensuring solutions are technically sound, commercially competitive, code-compliant, and executable.
The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise in power systems, electrical distribution, power generation, energy storage systems, and utility interconnections, along with demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams. This individual must excel in a fast-paced EPC environment, balancing multiple projects while driving standardization, quality, and continuous improvement.
This position must conform to all corporate policies and uphold ethical standards. This position will embody Lightserve ’s core values, exemplifying them with the utmost integrity. Employee will represent Lightserve and their department with the highest regard in both external and internal communications, ensuring a standard of excellence in all interactions.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead and develop the Applications Engineering team supporting BESS, generator, microgrid, and electrical infrastructure projects from opportunity identification through project turnover to execution.

• Provide technical leadership during project pursuit activities, including conceptual design, feasibility evaluations, equipment selection, energy system architecture, and cost optimization.

• Partner with Business Development, Estimating and Execution teams to develop technically accurate and competitive proposals, scopes of work, single-line diagrams, site layouts, and engineering narratives.

• Establish and maintain company engineering standards, design guidelines, and best practices across energy storage, generation, and electrical distribution projects.

• Oversee preparation and review of preliminary engineering deliverables, including:

• Single-line diagrams

• Equipment Site Layouts

• Load Flow Studies

• Ampacity analysis

• Short-circuit analyses

• Protection and coordination studies

• Arc flash studies

• Equipment specifications

• Utility interconnection support

• Permit and AHJ research

• Serve as technical authority for electrical system design, engineering calculations, and Professional Engineering review, signing, and sealing of projects where required.

• Coordinate with utilities, Independent System Operators (ISOs), Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), and external engineering partners regarding interconnections, permitting, and compliance requirements.

• Collaborate with Project Management, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning teams to ensure design intent, constructability, schedule adherence, and successful project execution.

• Support vendor qualification, equipment evaluation, and technical procurement activities for generators, switchgear, transformers, BESS equipment, inverters, and balance-of-plant systems.
